description: Lists Sitecore background jobs over the Authoring and Management API. jobName accepts wildcards: '*' for every job, 'myjob*' for names starting with it, '*myjob' for names ending with it, '*myjob*' for names containing it. Omit jobName to list them all. Use this to find out what the instance is busy with, or to locate a job whose exact name you do not know.

first.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

jobName.description: A job name or wildcard pattern, e.g. '*index'. Omit to list every job.

name: authoring-list-jobs
